parsed.result_reading: The robot falls forward in all 4 seeds. Median fall time 3.09 s, torso pitch at end 0.716 rad (forward lean), COM ahead of CoP at end 0.328 L, capture margin -0.604 L (outside forward), angular momentum forward 0.091, pitch rate 2.44 rad/s, step length 0.122 L (low), flight fraction 0.016 (high), pitch mean 0.181 rad (high), com height mean 0.611 L (low), friction utilisation p95 0.521 (high), slip fraction 0.0128 (slightly high). No joint torque saturation. These indicate excessive forward momentum and insufficient corrective balance or overly forward posture.

parsed.result_reading: After counterfactual E1 (balance_gain@x1.2 & hip_bias@-0.1R) on the initial design, all 4 observation seeds walked (n_walking=4, n_fell=0). Key improvements: time_upright rose from 3.09 s to 10.0 s; pitch_end dropped from 0.716 rad to 0.166 rad; com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_end fell from 0.328 to -0.010; capture_margin_over_L_end increased from -0.604 to -0.105 (less negative); angmom_norm_end decreased from 0.091 to 0.0017; friction_utilisation_p95 fell from 0.521 to 0.258; com_vx_mean reduced slightly from 0.393 to 0.314 m/s; step frequency remained within healthy range. The robot now exhibits upright posture, reduced forward lean, and stable capture point dynamics.

parsed.result_reading: No new observation of the current best design exists yet. The initial observation O0 showed all four seeds falling forward after a median time of 3.09 s, with large forward pitch (pitch_end ≈ 0.716 rad), COM far ahead of CoP (com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_end ≈ 0.328), strongly negative capture margin (capture_margin_over_L_end ≈ ‑0.604), and high angular momentum (angmom_norm_end ≈ 0.091). After the feedback repair (R1) the balance_gain was reduced from 82.26 to 68.31 while other feedback parameters changed (kp↑, kd↓, pitch_kp↑, sync_gain↓); hip_bias remained at 0.1995. No direct measurement of the post‑repair behavior is available.

Compared with the baseline observation of design 2 (O1), the following quantities changed beyond tolerance: fall_time decreased from 1.761 to 1.221 s; step_freq_hz decreased from 6.439 to 6.114 Hz; flight_fraction decreased from 0.1205 to 0.0928; com_vx_mean decreased from 0.5729 to 0.5132 m/s; com_vx_end decreased from 0.6896 to 0.6306 m/s; capture_margin_over_L_end increased (less negative) from -0.253 to -0.2201; cp_ahead_of_front_edge_over_L_mean decreased from 0.1879 to 0.1649; cp_ahead_of_front_edge_over_L_end decreased from 0.2154 to 0.1882; pitch_rate_end increased from -0.1387 to 0.09924 rad/s; pre_fall.pitch_rate decreased from -1.41 to -1.541 rad/s. No significant changes were observed in time_upright, pitch_end, com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_end, or angmom_norm_end.
